defectRule: Every EVO defect is traced to the earliest responsible stage, fixed in the reusable clinic_template layer when applicable and added to regression coverage.
successRule: Every repeatedly successful EVO pattern is evaluated for promotion into a reusable capability, component, strategy rule or asset-production rule.

learnings.lesson: Controlled input screens must keep stable React identity across keystrokes.
Mobile booking controls must remain in normal flow when sticky actions can cover provider CTAs.
UI visibility and external provider availability are separate capability states.
Every service group requires a unique semantic primary image within one campaign art direction.
